sections.text_helper: Section 49.8.21 "CRYP context swap GCM-CCM registers (CRYP_CSGCMCCMxR)" in chapter 49 (Cryptographic processor (CRYP)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2405.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x50 + 0x4 * x, (x=0 to 7)
Reset value: 0x00000000
Bits 31:0 CSGCMCCM[31:0]: Context swap for GCM/GMAC and CCM modes
CRYP_CSGCMCCMxR registers contain the complete internal register states of the CRYP
when the GCM, GMAC or CCM processing of the current task is suspended to process a
higher-priority task. Refer to Section49.4.8: CRYP suspend and resume operations for more
details.
CRYP_CSGCMCCMxR registers are not used in other chaining modes than GCM, GMAC or
CCM.
